notes.content: A wholly handwritten English letter, dated at Voorschoten, reports the dispatch of a manuscript on the tame fundamental group and borrowed papers (opening paragraph). It asks about scheme/prescheme and doublet terminology (paragraph 2), explains the cited EGA/SGA numbering (References paragraph), and gives comments keyed to manuscript pages 3, 5 and 6. The last comment distinguishes the word covering as a translation of revêtement from covering in a topology, and continues beyond this sheet after what. The margin has a sloping stroke label and line, SGA 1, a circled O.K followed by a doubtful dash/period, and a lower O.K. Authorship and the annotating hands are not identified from outside sources.

One extra reader crop concerned assumption rather than the targeted subtle punctuation; both are documented. R2 alone found the clear comma after it and the possible point before a colon; R1 alone qualified initial W and the name separator. The final keeps ink-supported uncertainty rather than voting.
